item.description: A new wedge issue appears in L.A. council races

item.title: Willie Colón, trombone and salsa legend, dies at 75
item.description: Throughout his career, Colón released more than 40 albums, pioneering a salsa sound influenced by the streets of New York City and beloved by Latin immigrant households around the globe.

item.title: Influencers want to adopt the 'analog lifestyle' for 2026. Here's how to join them
item.description: Influencers dubbed 2026 as the year of the "analog life." Experts say people are looking to reduce distractibility and related stress.

item.title: LAUSD borrowing $250 million to settle sex abuse claims — on top of earlier half billion
item.description: LAUSD expects to issue up to $750 million in bonds for sex abuse claims. Interest and fees push the tab over $1 billion. Other districts face similar claims.

item.title: Four dead in fiery car crash in Long Beach, federal agency investigating
item.description: The single-vehicle collision took place on Lakewood Boulevard, right next to Long Beach Airport.

item.title: Frustrated by chronic homelessness and severe illness, they found an answer hiding in plain sight
item.description: A psychiatrist and an attorney in San Diego say an existing statute could address severe mental illness and addiction.

item.title: Here's who is running in the heated race for insurance commissioner
item.description: The Democratic part will endorse its candidate for insurance commissioner this weekend, a typically sleepy race that has been upended by the January 2025 Los Angeles County fires.

item.title: L.A. County pushes to change law that opened floodgates for billions in sex abuse payouts
item.description: State legislators are considering changes to a law that extended the statute of limitations for lawsuits over sexual abuse, triggering a tidal wave of decades-old claims that local leaders warn has pushed budgets to the brink of bankruptcy.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 skiers killed in devastating avalanche recovered by authorities
item.description: California search-and-rescue teams have recovered the bodies of all nine missing skiers killed in a devastating avalanche in a remote region of Sierra Nevada

item.title: Democrats' fear rising that too many candidates in governor's race could lead to a Republican victory
item.description: Leaders of the California Democratic Party, along with liberal activists and loyal power brokers, are openly expressing fear that their crowded field of candidates running for governor may splinter the vote and open the door to a surprise Republican victory in November.
